_why: KAN-457. This file is the app repo's record of which Claude Design commit the
rendered UI was last reconciled against. It exists because the design system
lives in a DIFFERENT, PRIVATE repo (github.com/luisa-sys/lyra-design-system)
that this repo's CI cannot read, so the extraction DoD could only ever ask a
human to attest 'done' — and an attestation satisfied by typing a word is
indistinguishable from no control at all.
when a PR MOVES a file on a design-bearing surface, `baseline_ref` below must
change in the SAME PR. The claim is then backed by a diff, not a promise.
This does NOT prove the design system was actually re-pointed — CI still cannot
read that repo. It proves someone opened it, took its head, and recorded it
here. That is a deliberate, stated limit; see docs/MODULARISATION_EXTRACTION_DOD.md
section 2.2 and the CTL-040 registry entry.
note: KAN-487 part 3 deleted the legacy profile wizard/editor estate (src/app/dashboard/profile/legacy/page.tsx, wizard.tsx, steps/*, sections/*). CTL-040 flagged the deletions as design-bearing, and it was RIGHT: in the design repo, rebuild/sync-manifest.json globbed only deleted files (legacy/**, wizard.tsx) in the dev_paths of KAN-453, and rebuild/cards/github.md mapped the Profile Editor card to deleted sections/* and steps/* files. dev_paths is what the G3 promote-verified gate reads, so it would have kept passing over an empty set. Re-pointed there (KAN-453 dev_paths now src/app/dashboard/profile/page.tsx and edit-profile-form.tsx; the Profile Editor card row now lists edit-profile-form.tsx, editor/** and favourites.ts) rather than waved through here with a Design-Baseline-Ok trailer, since the coupling was real.
merged_as: 86b094b is the head of luisa-sys/lyra-design-system main after merging #7 (the KAN-487 re-point of KAN-453 dev_paths and the github card row), so this ref is reachable from the design system's default branch rather than only from a PR branch. Previous baseline 3c3ac22 was the squash of #2 (KAN-473).
